상대방을 진정시키거나, 무리하지 말라고 하거나,
헤어질 때 가볍게 인사하는 표현이에요.

It's just a game, take it easy!

상황에 따라 의미가 달라지는 아주 유용한 표현이에요.

snippet.description:
☕️커피 한 잔 후원하기
https://m.site.naver.com/1c3r4
감사합니다!

💬 Take it easy
뜻
상대방을 진정시키거나, 무리하지 말라고 하거나,
헤어질 때 가볍게 인사하는 표현이에요.

간단히 말해
👉 진정해, 화내지 마.
👉 무리하지 마, 쉬엄쉬엄 해.
👉 잘 가!

⸻

예문
It's just a game, take it easy!
→ 그냥 게임이잖아, 진정해!

You've been working all day. Take it easy.
→ 하루 종일 일했잖아. 좀 쉬엄쉬엄 해.

Okay, I'm leaving now. / All right, take it easy!
→ 나 먼저 갈게. / 알았어, 잘 가!

⸻

포인트

상황에 따라 의미가 달라지는 아주 유용한 표현이에요.

핵심 뉘앙스는 '긴장 풀고 편안하게' 예요.

뒤에 on을 붙여 Take it easy on someone이라고 하면 '~한테 너무 심하게 하지 마, 살살 해' 라는 뜻이 돼요.

en-US.title: English expressions that 90% of Koreans don't know Part 1 Take it easy #English conversation #Eng...
en-US.description:
☕️Sponsor a cup of coffee
https://m.site.naver.com/1c3r4
Thank you!

💬 Take it easy
Meaning
This expression is used to calm someone down, tell them not to overexert themselves, or as a light goodbye when parting ways.

In short,
👉 Calm down, don't get angry.

👉 Don't overexert yourself, take it easy.

👉 Bye!

⸻

Example
It's just a game, take it easy!
→ It's just a game, take it easy!

You've been working all day. Take it easy.
→ You've been working all day. Take it easy.

Okay, I'm leaving now. / All right, take it easy!
→ I'll go first. / Okay, bye!

⸻

Point

This is a very useful expression whose meaning changes depending on the situation.

The key nuance is "relax and take it easy."

If you add "on" to the end, "Take it easy on someone," it means "Don't be too hard on them. Take it easy."
